title: ERC4626YieldStrategy credits principal via fee-blind convertToAssets, persistently over-stating redeemable NAV
additionalLocations: ERC4626YieldStrategy.sol:115 (creditedPrincipal = vault.convertToAssets(sharesReceived) — the fee-blind idle-NAV credit, source-verified)
src/AYieldStrategy.sol:748 (base write-down site the over-stated principal feeds)
lib/stable-staker/src/StableStaker.sol:786 (F-03 / M-05 cross-protocol consumer of principalOf — integration gate)
story: story-049 (YS-01: credit principal via convertToAssets — Autopool STATICCALL fix)
description: story-049 changed the deposit credit in ERC4626YieldStrategy._acquireShares from previewRedeem(sharesReceived) to convertToAssets(sharesReceived) to fix the Tokemak Autopool STATICCALL brick (YS-01: some real vaults mutate state inside previewRedeem and revert with StateChangeDuringStaticCall when called as an external view). convertToAssets is the fee-blind idle-NAV exchange rate: on the deployed Tokemak autopools convertToAssets(shares) >= previewRedeem(shares), because previewRedeem reflects exit fees / curve effects that convertToAssets ignores. As a result principalOf / totalBalanceOf persistently OVER-STATE the redeemable NAV — the strategy books more principal than it could actually realise by redeeming. The over-statement propagates to the base write-down site (AYieldStrategy.sol:748) and out to the cross-protocol consumer StableStaker.sol:786 (the F-03 / stable-staker M-05 integration callsite).
impact: No value leaves the protocol on this commit's wiring and no external attacker exists. The defect is a persistent NAV over-statement whose MEASURED magnitude on the deployed autopools is below protocol slippage tolerances (see measuredMagnitude), which is why this is an honest Low at this configuration. CRITICAL: the magnitude is bound to the EXTERNAL vault's fee/curve config, not to this contract — the same code path becomes a Medium if a future strategy is wired to a vault with a non-trivial exit fee (see severityScaling).

measuredMagnitude.scaleBehavior: FLAT across 1 unit -> 5M units; rises to ~3 bps only near full-pool-drain.
measuredMagnitude.conclusion: Below protocol slippage tolerances on the deployed autopools -> honest Low at this configuration.

severityScaling.boundTo: external vault fee / curve config — NOT this contract
severityScaling.mechanism: Over-credit scales LINEARLY with the external vault exit fee. PoC: a 1% exit-fee vault yields a 10e18 over-credit on a 1000e18 deposit.
severityScaling.escalation: If a future strategy is wired to a non-trivial-exit-fee vault, this SAME code path is a MEDIUM (depositors over-credited, last-out shortfall realisable). Retain the F-03 StableStaker:786 integration gate with a 'magnitude = external vault fee config' annotation so a future high-fee vault does not silently inherit a stale Low.

lawBasis: Law-3 non-obvious owner/integrator footgun (surprise test PASSES: a non-trivial exit fee silently inflates booked principal). Law-1 recall: parked at honest Low with a documented magnitude-bound escalation note rather than dropped. NOT an unsafe story — story-049's convertToAssets choice correctly fixes the STATICCALL brick; the residual is the fee-blindness it introduces.
documentationCheck: NOT-BLESSED. knownIssuesCount=0; no designDecision documents that booked principal is the fee-blind idle-NAV rather than the realizable redeem value. The _acquireShares NatSpec (ERC4626YieldStrategy.sol:93/95) actively MIS-states the behaviour ('credits the full nominal amount (no haircut)') — that doc-contradiction is the faithfulness leg F-16-003.
tier3Evidence: Two workspace PoCs. poc-econ-a-exitfee-overcredit.t.sol (mechanism: a non-zero-exit-fee vault over-credits principal linearly with the fee; a zero-fee vault shows no gap) PASSES 2/2 (re-run this run). fork-econ-a-autodola-navgap.t.sol (real magnitude: convertToAssets vs previewRedeem gap on autoDOLA / autoUSD, flat across deposit size) PASSES 6/6.
recommendation: Mirror the sibling ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy._creditedPrincipal conservative haircut (lines ~106-133) — credit the conservative (lower) realizable value — or credit a STATICCALL-safe realizable value rather than the fee-blind convertToAssets. Do NOT revert to previewRedeem (that reintroduces the YS-01 Autopool STATICCALL brick). Until fixed, retain the F-03 StableStaker:786 integration gate annotated 'magnitude = external vault fee config' so a future high-fee vault is re-evaluated at Medium.
